# Aura · Children and young people

> A public proposal by Luke Nathan Hayes for supported learning, personal Aura, relationships, rights and opportunities for adulthood in Australian care.

Canonical website: https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-child-services/
Source repository: https://github.com/auraofintelligence/aura-child-services
Licence: https://github.com/auraofintelligence/aura-child-services/blob/main/LICENCE.md
Rights: https://github.com/auraofintelligence/aura-child-services/blob/main/RIGHTS.md
Original document: https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-child-services/documents/Aura_Genesis_Children_and_Teens_Australian_Care.docx

## Public pages
- [Welcome](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-child-services/): Understand powerful AI, ask better questions and create something of your own. This proposal connects young people’s agency with ethical technology, trusted adults and real opportunities to grow.
- [A wider opportunity](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-child-services/opportunity.html): The proposal connects everyday childhood opportunity with a wider question: how can young people share in the capabilities of increasingly powerful intelligence?
- [Aura and self understanding](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-child-services/personal-aura.html): A supported computing station offers a place to make, learn and reflect. The young person brings the meaning; the record can change as their understanding grows.
- [Understanding law](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-child-services/law-and-rights.html): Follow a question to a readable source. Learn why a rule exists, whose decision it affects and what needs checking in the present setting.
- [A first project](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-child-services/first-project.html): A small creative project can reveal what someone enjoys, what gets in the way and which person or resource would help them continue.
- [Family, care and identity](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-child-services/family-and-identity.html): A life can hold several important relationships. Chosen memories, useful information and cultural connections need room to retain their meaning through change.
- [Growing into adult life](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-child-services/adult-opportunities.html): Mentors, practical work experience, shared productive ownership and planned time for life offer different possibilities to investigate as young people grow into adulthood.
- [Contribution and wellbeing](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-child-services/community.html): A useful task, a shared meal or a welcoming invitation can connect people. Communities choose their recognition, while essential support remains independent of contribution.
- [2032 and civic futures](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-child-services/civic-futures.html): Local learning and a lasting volunteer network connect the Olympic horizon with young adults investigating the future of their communities, Earth and space.
- [People and personal control](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-child-services/people-and-control.html): The young person can ask questions, correct a record and turn to accountable adults. Learning, recording, research and publication each need an understandable purpose and actual arrangements.
- [Developing the proposal](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-child-services/development.html): A useful pilot needs a willing host, time, support and something concrete to try. Young people help shape it, and what happens changes the next step.
- [Sources and original document](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-child-services/sources.html): Read the unchanged original, follow every project and public-guidance reference, and distinguish the proposal from evidence about outcomes.
- [Connected projects](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-child-services/connections.html): Related projects offer background, tools and development directions. Each has its own scope and status; a link does not establish a service or partnership.
- [About and licence](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-child-services/licence.html): A public reading guide to Luke Nathan Hayes’s proposal, with the original document, exact source links and clearly identified concept artwork.
- [Sitemap](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-child-services/sitemap.html): Follow the chapters in sequence or begin with the question that matters to you.

The child and teen proposal uses Verse Box and everyday learning, not adult pressure treatment. Adult teacher training is facilitator context. C-Hours are nonmonetary voluntary contribution; essential support is independent. This is a public proposal, not an operating care service, recruitment platform or qualification. Discovery grants no additional reuse or AI-training rights.
